title: C hal: two-slot redundant-record storage layer (provision/open/update) over an ops vtable
description: Remaining slice of b7z9.11.1 after codec (x04u). Port rust/lichen-hal/src/storage.rs provision_redundant/open_redundant/update_redundant to C in lichen/subsys/lichen/hal/hal_storage_redundant.c, storage-agnostic via an ops vtable in the project style (cf. struct lichen_replay_store_ops in replay_persist.h): read(user,key,out,cap,*len) -> 0 found / 1 missing / -errno; write(user,key,value,len). Semantics per Rust: provision fails if either key present (Exists), writes slot A generation 1; open returns newest valid generation with Missing vs Corrupt taxonomy and buffer-too-small; update re-parses both slots, rejects Stale when caller's (generation,slot) doesn't match current, Exhausted at u64 generation max, writes the OPPOSITE slot at generation+1. Keys 'rpl.tx.a'/'rpl.tx.b' and magic 'DTX2' stay with the CALLER (child b7z9.11.2), not the primitive. Host tests in lichen/tests/hal_storage_redundant: empty->Missing, corrupt->Corrupt, provision Exists, update alternation a/b/a, stale detection, generation wrap (u64 max), rollback... note Rust has no explicit rollback (write failure -> Storage error, old slot intact) - pin that. Test double-write failure path.
close_reason: Two-slot redundant-record storage primitive landed (commits a35d064f6e + review fixes incl. the P0 OOB guard): lichen/subsys/lichen/hal/hal_storage_redundant.{c,include/lichen/hal_storage_redundant.h} + host test lichen/tests/hal_storage_redundant (7 cases) + hal CMakeLists registration + puck native_sim board confs supply the missing COAP_KEYS dep. Semantics mirror rust/lichen-hal/src/storage.rs exactly: provision (Exists-gate both keys, slot A gen 1, write failure -> STORAGE with old slot intact), open (newest valid generation; Missing vs Corrupt vs BufferTooSmall taxonomy incl. full-length overflow detection via the ops *len contract), update (re-parse both slots fresh, Stale on (gen,slot) mismatch, neither-present->Stale vs present-but-corrupt->Corrupt distinction, Exhausted at u64 max, opposite-slot write at gen+1). Storage-agnostic via ops vtable in the project style. Review 3x delegated to kimi-k3: found+fixed a real [P0] OOB read (update never checked raw_a_len/raw_b_len vs the stack scratch buffer — a stored record >279 bytes caused parse/crc reads past the buffer; now guarded to CORRUPT matching Rust's overflow mapping), plus noted-not-defect divergences: C returns ENCODE error where Rust .expect() panics (improvement), provision EXISTS short-circuit masks a combined B-fault (P3 divergence, both fault classes are hard failures), and open prioritizes STORAGE over BUFFER_TOO_SMALL on combined faults (P3, ordering divergence only). Native_sim puck board confs also gained the missing COAP_KEYS dep (link errors pre-dating this bead). Verification: host build+run all asserts green (7 cases); lichen-gateway lib 234/234 (board conf fix verified via puck native_sim build); cppcheck clean.
